name: @hia-doc/hia-jsdoc-workspace
description: Workspace for HIA JSDoc preset, runner and bridge packages.

scripts.check:syntax: node --check scripts/check-skeleton.cjs && node --check scripts/check-license-audit.cjs && node --check scripts/release-check.cjs && node --check scripts/build-fixtures.cjs && node --check scripts/check-fixtures.cjs && node --check packages/jsdoc-spec/src/index.mjs && node --check packages/jsdoc-extra-plugin-registry/src/index.mjs && node --check packages/jsdoc-plugin-hia-bridge/src/index.mjs && node --check packages/jsdoc-theme-bridge/src/index.mjs && node --check packages/jsdoc-doc-source-map/src/index.mjs && node --check packages/jsdoc-preset/src/index.mjs && node --check packages/jsdoc-runner/src/index.mjs
scripts.release:gate: npm run check:syntax && npm run build:fixtures && npm run check:skeleton && npm run check:fixtures && npm run license:audit && npm test && npm run release:check && npm pack --dry-run --json
